name: sitepulse
description: SitePulse - Integrated Website Support, Feedback and Analytics Platform

scripts.build: npm --prefix dashboard install && npm --prefix dashboard run build && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate && npm --prefix backend run prisma:push
scripts.prestart: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), cp = require('child_process'); if (!fs.existsSync('dashboard/dist/index.html')) { console.log('Building dashboard before starting server...'); cp.execSync('npm --prefix dashboard run build', { stdio: 'inherit' }); }"
